about.title: Not a course. A placement cell for every student.
about.subtitle: Shortlisted is HireKarma's subscription-based placement program — curated batches, dedicated coordinators, and matched jobs through the DISHA platform.
about.storyTitle: The placement cell, without the college
about.storyBody: Most students outside top campuses never get a real placement cell — no coordinator, no curated jobs, no one tracking their applications. Shortlisted fixes that with a structured program built for outcomes.
about.storyBody2: Subscribe once, join a batch of 12, and work with a dedicated coordinator who knows your profile, your applications, and your timeline — until you get placed.

highlights.title: Small batch model
highlights.body: Only 12 students per batch — so your coordinator actually knows you, not just your roll number.

highlights.title: Curated job matching
highlights.body: Jobs from the DISHA corporate network, assigned to your batch based on skills and preferences.

highlights.title: Live tracking
highlights.body: Shortlist, interview, and offer status updated in your dashboard — no guessing, no ghosting.

impact.title: Structured for real placements
impact.subtitle: One subscription unlocks your entire placement cell — batch, coordinator, jobs, and tracking.

journey.title: From signup to offer letter
journey.subtitle: Five clear milestones — each with coordinator support at every step.

milestones.title: Register your profile
milestones.body: Sign up in English, Hindi, or Odia. Add skills, college, and target roles in minutes.

milestones.title: Subscribe & secure your seat
milestones.body: One-time payment unlocks placement cell access and assigns you to the current open batch.

milestones.title: Join your batch of 12
milestones.body: Your coordinator introduces the batch, sets expectations, and starts tracking your progress.

milestones.title: Apply to curated jobs
milestones.body: DISHA admins assign relevant openings. Apply with one click and track every status live.

milestones.title: Get placed
milestones.body: Interview prep, follow-ups, and offer support — until you join your new role.

explore.title: Ready to join?
explore.subtitle: Limited seats per batch. Start with a free profile — subscribe when you're ready.

cards.title: Claim your seat
cards.body: Register and subscribe to join the current batch before seats fill up.

cards.title: Student login
cards.body: Already registered? Sign in to your dashboard, jobs, and applications.

cards.title: Talk to us
cards.body: Questions about batches, pricing, or the program? Our team is one call away.

contact.title: We're here to help
contact.subtitle: Reach our team for batch enquiries, subscription support, or application questions. We respond quickly on call and WhatsApp.
contact.reachBody: Prefer a quick chat? Call or message us — we help students and coordinators across India.
contact.helpBody: Our team assists with registration, subscriptions, batch assignment, and application tracking.
contact.hoursBody: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST. WhatsApp messages are answered within 30 minutes during business hours.
contact.safetyBody: Shortlisted is a placement program — not a course. Never pay anyone outside the official checkout for batch access.
